title: Indonesia’s United Tractors seeks expansion with gold miner acquisition

title: Indonesia cites lack of forestry permits in land seizures from nickel miners

title: Nickel price gains after Indonesia seizes part of giant mine
body: A government task force took control on Thursday of about 148 hectares of the operation owned by PT Weda Bay Nickel.

title: Nickel shortage, higher costs pinch Indonesian producers
body: Permitting issues are a key reason for the ore scarcity.

title: Indonesia’s Merdeka says its gold subsidiary will launch $300M IPO

title: Anglo-Peabody mine tussle leaves Indonesian mining firm seeking new coal assets
body: PT Buma Internasional is still on the hunt for coal assets, as uncertainty lingers about its planned purchase of a stake in the Dawson project.

title: Indonesia Aims to Dominate Global Nickel Supply Chain Amid Production Expansion and Import Challenges
body: APNI’s Meidy Katrin Lengkey highlighted Indonesia’s 414k‑ton nickel consumption and 54 active smelters (plus 49 under construction) as the country positions itself to meet a projected 700m‑ton demand this year, while noting reliance on Philippine imports and a shift from a 3‑year to a 1‑year RKAB plan that may delay policy support until 2026. She forecasted nickel prices at $15,000–$16,000 next year and urged government action to keep production costs competitive, stressing that Indonesia must add value through NPI, MHP, and battery manufacturing to fully capture the economic benefits.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Mining Sector Faces Rising Costs as B40 Biodiesel Program Under Review
body: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources is evaluating the 40% biodiesel (B40) mandate, noting a 3–5% rise in nickel mining production costs amid a 15,000‑t/ton drop in nickel prices and added export‑regulation burdens. Stakeholders call for quarterly reviews, supply‑chain guarantees, and policy flexibility to avoid further strain on smelters and prepare for a potential 50% biodiesel (B50) shift next year.
